title: KYE Self-Audit Run
description: Output of a KYE Self-Audit & Attestation Profile™ run. Covers the 17 canonical audit areas (schema, dictionary, profile, registry, entity_state, authority_grant, delegation_path, capability_state, credential_binding, policy_binding, decision_correctness, reason_code_correctness, audit_trail_integrity, evidence_completeness, webhook_delivery_integrity, graph_consistency, recovery_revocation_correctness).

provenance.description: How the summary test counts were derived. Present when the run's counts come from an actual executed signal rather than a hand-asserted constant. The build-self-audit-snapshot builder refuses to write without this block, so a snapshot lacking provenance is, by construction, not a real run.

derivation.description: executed = the builder ran the command itself; supplied-from-execution = the counts were parsed from a real run by a caller and passed in with the originating command recorded.

command.description: The exact command whose output produced tests_total/tests_passed.

source.description: Identifier of the signal the counts came from, e.g. 'ci-parity-runner' or 'conformance-runner-vitest'.

key_class.description: Provenance of the signing key used when this run was sealed into a signed bundle: ci-fixture = the in-repo self-audit fixture key matching the published JWKS; production-hsm = the live key whose private half lives in HSM/KMS.
